description:
Source code and supporting files for LMSFE-YOLO, a detector for UAV small-object detection combining LCSM, C3k2-MSEE, and HE-PAN.

The repository contains model configurations, training, evaluation and inference entry points, dependency specifications, dataset access instructions, and machine-readable CSV result files.

Software is distributed under GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later. Author-generated numerical result files in ultralytics/results are distributed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party benchmark images and original annotations are obtained from their official providers under their respective terms.
